title: Why Your Westchester Home Addition Needs Both an Architect and General Contractor Under One Roof
excerpt: When you're adding square footage to your home in Westchester, you need someone who understands both the vision and the build. That's what design-build delivers, and it's why homeowners across the county turn to House Architecture & Construction.
content:
Adding onto your home is one of the biggest decisions you'll make as a homeowner. You're investing time, money, and trust into a project that will shape how your family lives for years to come. The challenge is that most home addition projects require two separate professionals: an architect to design it, and a general contractor to build it. When those two don't communicate the way they should, things get messy fast.

That's where the design-build approach changes everything. At House Architecture & Construction, Silvio M. Luca is both a licensed architect in New York and a licensed general contractor in Westchester. He runs every project personally, which means the person designing your addition is the same person building it. No handoffs. No miscommunications. No surprises.

What Makes Design-Build Different for Home Additions in Westchester

When you work with a traditional architect, they design based on vision and code. When you work with a traditional contractor, they build based on the plan and the budget. But what if those two things don't align perfectly? A design-build firm solves that problem because the architect-contractor knows in real time whether a design choice makes sense constructively and financially.

This matters whether you're planning a second-story addition in Scarsdale, a kitchen and living space expansion in Larchmont, or a primary suite addition in Rye. The approach is the same: thoughtful design meets practical construction knowledge from day one.

Homeowners in Bronxville, Mamaroneck, and Pelham often come to us because they want certainty. They don't want surprises mid-project. When your architect is also your contractor, that trust is built into the process.

Permits and Planning Across Westchester County

Every town in Westchester has its own building department and permit process. Whether you're in White Plains, New Rochelle, Harrison, or Eastchester, you need someone who knows the local requirements and can navigate them smoothly. Having a residential architect based in Westchester who also holds a general contractor's license means someone who understands all these jurisdictions from experience.

Silvio has completed work across the county, from historic restorations in Tarrytown to open-concept conversions in Hastings-on-Hudson. He knows what each town requires and how to present your project the right way.

From Concept to Move-In Day

Whether your vision is a modest kitchen refresh or a significant home renovation in Westchester, the design-build process keeps you in the loop. You're not handing off your project from one person to another. You're working with one professional who sees the whole picture and takes responsibility for the result.

If you're ready to explore a home addition for your Westchester home, call House Architecture & Construction at (914) 224-7383 for a free consultation. Silvio will listen to what you want to accomplish and explain how design-build can make it happen without the typical friction.
